mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, shop_name AS shopName, shop_logo AS shopLogo, description, contact_phone AS contactPhone, status, audit_status AS auditStatus, audit_remark AS auditRemark, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM `merchant` WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `merchant` (user_id, shop_name, shop_logo, description, contact_phone, status, audit_status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{shopName}, #{shopLogo}, #{description}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{auditStatus})
